claimChecks.claim: Any <500mL asymptomatic scan is inappropriate for catheterization; symptomatic lower volume automatically requires it
claimChecks.locator: Publisher full article Table 2 and algorithm caption, adult inpatients
claimChecks.note: 400–499mL asymptomatic uncertain; symptomatic 100–299 uncertain, ≥300 appropriate for intermittent; evaluation distinct from treatment.

claimChecks.claim: Scanner always avoids catheterization and has no contraindication, including ascites or pregnancy
claimChecks.locator: Chrouser Table 1/2 and i10 Rev07 pp 2–4 warnings
claimChecks.note: i10 specifically excludes ascites, pregnancy and open suprapubic wounds; in-service model and clinical context govern alternatives.

claimChecks.claim: Pre-scan universally improves accuracy and a 2025 Jeong study proves broad-range clinical segmentation
claimChecks.locator: Park and Brouwer primary abstracts, i10 pp 41–45
claimChecks.note: Two-device Park result not isolating prescan; Brouwer found no Prime prescan accuracy gain; untraceable Jeong claim removed while i10 live B-mode teaching retained.

claimChecks.claim: Palese proves 28–35 percent fewer catheterizations and eliminates CAUTI for every urogyn voiding trial
claimChecks.locator: 2010 article methods/results Tables 1–2 and forest text pp 2–6
claimChecks.note: Three heterogeneous historical postoperative studies report UTI OR 0.27; no procedure-specific reduction or zero-risk claim.

claimChecks.claim: 24mL/3.3mL bias makes every scan sufficiently accurate at any treatment threshold, including augmented bladder
claimChecks.locator: Primary abstracts/indexed results, augmented subgroup and BMI subgroup
claimChecks.note: Device and patient context made explicit; small average bias is not individual agreement; full tables still open.

claimChecks.claim: Lilium alpha-200 is currently available default for neurogenic home monitoring
claimChecks.locator: Manufacturer α-200 discontinued notice and current Japan lineup
claimChecks.note: Retained historical scheduled/continuous mode but removed current purchase recommendation; US availability not inferred.

claimChecks.claim: Araklitis 2019 shows calcified interpubic disc impairs suprapubic automatic scanners
claimChecks.note: That study evaluated conventional ultrasound formulas and fluoroscopic estimates; unsupported attribution removed.
